header.title: My account
header.description: Your plan belongs to your account and applies to the servers you choose.

change.extend: The months are added to the end of the period you already have.
change.startWithCredit: The new period starts when the Pix is approved. The time you didn't use is already discounted.
change.startNoCredit: The new period starts when the Pix is approved and replaces the current one, with no discount.
change.cardCancelled: The card subscription is cancelled at that moment.

pix.invalidEmail: Enter a valid email (it goes on the Pix receipt).
pix.notCompleted: The payment wasn't completed. Generate a new Pix if you want to try again.
pix.title: Pay {plan} for {package} via Pix
pix.subtitle: In one payment, no recurrence and {emphasis}, from any bank app or PicPay.
pix.scanHint: Scan the QR or copy the code below. Confirmation is automatic within seconds of paying.

cancel.title: Cancel subscription?
cancel.descriptionPrepaid: You lose the benefits now and the remaining time isn't refunded. To keep using it, you'll need to subscribe again.
cancel.description: You lose the Pro benefits immediately. To keep using it, you'll need to subscribe again.

pastDue: Your last charge failed. Renew the subscription on your plan's card, with another card or via Pix (it becomes prepaid), within 3 days so you don't lose access.

pending.processing: Waiting for Mercado Pago to confirm the payment (up to 5 min). If you've already paid, reload in a few seconds.
pending.started: You started the upgrade to the {plan} plan but the payment hasn't been confirmed yet. Continue or cancel.
pending.processingHint: Wait for Mercado Pago to confirm before trying again

card.creditApplied: {amount} from the time you didn't use is already discounted.
card.cancelToFree: Cancel the paid plan to go back to Free.

selfTrial.description: No card and no charge at the end. The trial is available once per account and once per server. When it ends, the server goes back to Free and paid modules are turned off.
selfTrial.guildLabel: Server that will get the trial
selfTrial.noGuilds: Add the bot to one of your servers to start the trial.
selfTrial.noEligibleGuilds: None of your servers can get the trial right now.

selfTrial.tooNew: The free {plan} trial becomes available for your account on {date}.
